description: This Java class defines the configuration for an activity check policy, including duration settings for inactive and deleted intervals. It provides methods to instantiate the configuration from external Config objects and implements equality, hash, and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultActivityCheckConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that provides configuration settings for activity checks, including inactive and deleted intervals.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultActivityCheckConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getInactiveInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration for inactive interval.

methods.name: getDeletedInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration for deleted interval.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on inactive and deleted intervals.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on inactive and deleted intervals.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation of the configuration.
